answer: Behavior fingerprint escrow unlock: each new identity stakes 60 POA, released only when its behavior fingerprint, the ridge of its task mix and timing, holds honest for 10 epochs. A quartz clock times each heartbeat; drift or copy-paste timing freezes it for peer review. A gale of new identities must each pay and prove the same fingerprint. Forging 1,000 costs 60,000 POA locked 10 epochs. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
